newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia EPE plans bonus, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia EPE plans bonus, rights issues.

text.p: Malaysia's independent power producer EPE Power Corp Bhd has proposed a one-for-two bonus issue of 6.0 million shares and a three-for-five rights issue of 7.2 million shares at 8.80 ringgit a share.

In a statement, EPE said it also proposed to increase its authorised share capital to 50 million shares of 1.00 ringgit each, from 20 million, to accommodate the increase in the paid-up capital of the company pursuant to the bonus and rights issues.
EPE's paid-up capital will rise to 25.2 million ringgit from the existing 12 million after the two issues.

Proceeds of the rights issue will be used for investments in subsidiaries and associated companies, capital expenditure to construct sub-stations for power distribution, and to repay bank borrowings, said EPE.
